subject: Contracting Kickoff: canonical party mapping, billing entity, and redline flags
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@ledgerworks.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, contracts@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: LedgerWorks MSA + Order Form (redlines attached)

Hi Kimberly / Karthik / Redwood contracts team,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Attached are our redlined MSA (PDF) and a completed Order Form (xlsx). Procurement asked that we surface a couple of items up front to speed review:

- Canonical party name / billing entity: LedgerWorks, Inc. (EIN pending; I can send tonight) — but our legal team sometimes routes billing to a separate payout entity (LedgerWorks Payments LLC). Can you confirm which entity Redwood needs on the Order Form/invoice?
- Data residency exhibit: we require EU-residency language for EU customer data (we have offices in EU/EIRE).
- Indemnity / cap: we’ve proposed a reciprocal 1% of ARR cap in the redline—please flag if that’s a hard stop.
- SOC2 + Data Processing Addendum: procurement needs a copy of your SOC2 report and a signed DPA.

Timeline: procurement would like a finalized MSA + order form within two weeks if possible. Please let me know the best person to coordinate evidence and signature routing (DocuSign).

Attachments: LedgerWorks_MSA_v0.9_redline.pdf (annotated), LedgerWorks_OrderForm_20261001.xlsx

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager, LedgerWorks
sarah.lee@ledgerworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Fwd: LedgerWorks MSA + Order Form (redlines attached) — intake / asks

Marissa / Naomi — forwarding LedgerWorks redlines and initial asks. Quick intake summary below and requested actions.

Summary (external asks):
- Confirm canonical legal party for contract vs billing entity (LedgerWorks, Inc. vs LedgerWorks Payments LLC) — external will provide EIN tonight.
- Data residency: they want EU-residency language for EU customer data (exhibit/Annex).
- Indemnity/cap: they proposed reciprocal 1% ARR — flag negotiation posture.
- Evidence: SOC2 + signed DPA required by procurement.

Attachments have redline highlights (see attached PDF). I uploaded originals to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExample (folder: /sales/ledgerworks).

Immediate asks (owners):
- Marissa: please prepare a party/billing-entity mapping table and a suggested Order Form fill (I started a sheet — attach mapping). Deadline: EOD tomorrow so we can confirm invoice entity.
- Naomi: first-pass legal redline flags — prioritize indemnity / cap, data residency exhibit, and termination/payment language. Can you aim for 48-hour turnaround?
- Karthik: please confirm the negotiation guardrails (discounts, cap flexibility).

Target: respond to LedgerWorks with clarifying questions + initial timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Date: 2026-10-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LedgerWorks MSA + Order Form (redlines attached) — intake / asks

Thanks — I pulled the attachments and did a first-pass mapping. Key notes:

1) Billing / invoice entity
- Proposal: we should put "LedgerWorks, Inc." as the contracting party on the MSA and preserve a separate "Billing Entity" field on the Order Form where we can list LedgerWorks Payments LLC if they request invoices paid there. That keeps the contract anchored to their legal entity while giving finance the billing routing.
- Action: Kimberly, if you approve this mapping I’ll update the Order Form worksheet and draft a short note for the external POC to confirm EIN and remittance details.

2) Redline priorities (first-pass)
- Indemnity / cap: LedgerWorks' 1% ARR reciprocal cap is below our usual floor. Recommend counter to 2% ARR or $500k min (whichever is higher). Naomi — please advise on precedent.
- Data residency exhibit: recommend we offer Annex B with two options: (a) EU-residency for EU data with specific subprocessors list redacted pending DPA, or (b) a geo-specific SLA and routing controls.
- Payment / termination: there are a couple of client-favorable payment timelines (net 60). Suggest net 45 as compromise.

3) Evidence & signature path
- I exported the redline PDF to Drive and created an "OrderForm_Fill" tab in the workbook. See folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExample (sales/ledgerworks).
- For SOC2: finance/legal can share the SOC2 redacted report once procurement signs an NDA; Naomi — do we want to use the standard SOC2 share flow?

I'll attach the mapping spreadsheet (LedgerWorks_party_mapping_v1.xlsx) to the internal folder. Let me know if we should surface a single exec sponsor for a small credit request or SLA exception.

To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@ledgerworks.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks MSA + Order Form (redlines attached) — confirm next steps

Hi Sarah / Alan — thanks for sending the redlines and the Order Form. Quick note from our side and a couple of clarifying requests so we can turn this around quickly.

1) Party & billing entity
- For the MSA: please confirm the legal contracting name you want on the Agreement (we recommend LedgerWorks, Inc.).
- For invoicing: we can preserve a Billing Entity field on the Order Form. Please confirm whether LedgerWorks Payments LLC should be used for remittance, and include the EIN for the contracting party when available.

2) Data residency / exhibits
- We can offer an Annex (Exhibit D) that memorializes EU-residency controls for EU customer data. Naomi will propose language and options (Annex + DPA) — expect that early next week.

3) Indemnity / cap & payment terms
- Our first-pass position: we generally seek a reciprocal cap that scales with ARR; as a compromise we may propose a 2% ARR or $500k minimum. Naomi will confirm legal posture.
- Payment term compromise: we can consider net 45 vs your net 60 request as a middle ground.

4) Evidence & signature routing
- We have a SOC2 report and our standard DPA; we typically share SOC2 under an NDA and will provide a DPA for signature. For signature routing, will DocuSign be acceptable? If yes, please confirm signer and email for Exec signature.

Next steps / timeline:
- Naomi (legal) to deliver first-pass redline response and recommended counter language for indemnity/data residency by Tue 10/6 EOD.
- Marissa to send updated Order Form with the Billing Entity field and mapping by tomorrow EOD.
- Kimberly / Karthik to confirm any commercial guardrails for cap/discounts by tomorrow.

We’ll send a consolidated reply to procurement with the updated Order Form, redline notes, and a proposed DocuSign path once those items are ready.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
